title: Notice regarding conduct of Foreman Skill Test under the Foreman (Motor Car Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024 08-Aug-2025 08-Aug-2025 View...
text:
KEY LINES:
(Motor Car Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024 (Advertisement No. PHC/03/2024
dated 28.05.2024) is scheduled to be held on 23rd August 2025 (Saturday), from 11:00 AM

FULL TEXT:
FOREMAN (MOTOR CAR GARAGE) RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2024
NOTICE
No.- 58/R&A Dated: 08th August, 2025
This is for information to all concerned that Foreman Skill Test under the Foreman
(Motor Car Garage) Recruitment Examination, 2024 (Advertisement No. PHC/03/2024
dated 28.05.2024) is scheduled to be held on 23rd August 2025 (Saturday), from 11:00 AM
onwards at the Court’s Garage located within the premises of the Court.
Admit cards of eligible candidates have been uploaded on the official website of the High
Court i.e. https://patnahighcourt.gov.in. Candidates are advised to download their admit cards
using their login credentials and report to the designated test venue on the scheduled date by
10:30 AM sharp. No candidates will be permitted to appear at the test who reports after 10:45
AM.
Requests for change in test venue or its timing will not be entertained under any
circumstances.
Admit card would not be sent to the candidates separately through any other mode. The
eligible candidates shall also be intimated through SMS and e-mail on their registered mobile
number and e-mail ID in this regard. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the test.
The candidates are directed to strictly follow the instructions mentioned in the Admit
Card. They are also directed to paste their passport size colour photograph at the space provided
in the admit card. Candidates are also required to bring their valid identity proof, in original,
with its photocopy at the test venue.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details / updates.
By order of the Court
Sd/-P.K.Malik
Registrar General
